recall_results.summary: M5 Hot/Warm/Cold tiering uses a streaming t-digest quantile estimator over per-cluster strength to choose adaptive tier boundaries; cold memories are excluded from non-Exploratory queries.
evidence_preview: cold tier excluded from non-Exploratory queries

recall_results.summary: Provenance-preserving merge keeps every merged memory's evidence row attached to the canonical so dedup never destroys source data.
STM has a half-life of 5 days and LTM 11 days under the fixed Ebbinghaus fallback; critical memories never decay.
STM promotes to LTM at access_count > 5 by default; cluster-aware promotion uses survival-curve-derived thresholds when curves are populated.
Search is a 3-channel waterfall: Tantivy BM25 full-text plus usearch HNSW vector plus knowledge-graph BFS; results are fused with RRF or learned CC alpha.
evidence_preview: RRF and learned CC alpha fusion

recall_results.summary: Query expansion rewrites the user query into 2-3 variants via Gemini Flash Lite or OMLX; expanded variants run in parallel with the original query.
evidence_preview: Gemini Flash Lite or OMLX backend

recall_results.summary: Autonomous retrieval routing classifies queries into Episodic, Temporal, Preference, ExactKeyword, Semantic, or Exploratory and picks per-strategy fusion alpha and result limit.
evidence_preview: rule-based classifier with no LLM call
